checklist: The checklist is closer to 60% true completion, per PowerPyx — you do not need everything. The thresholds are: 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned · 100 of 255 animals studied through the binoculars · 70 of 80 challenges · 300 stunts · 15 meditation spots on the checklist (the trophy counts 18) · 50 of 66 weapons. Earlier progress counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable.
intro: About 200 hours, difficulty 4/10, one playthrough, no online trophies — PowerPyx. The story takes 60–80 hours; the 100% checklist takes about 100 more. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission. Guides report that cheats disable trophies and saving, so leave them off for the whole run.

steps: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing and the mission Breakfast Run, then play Chapter 1 to its end.

Do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house FIRST — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. It is the one session in the game that can be missed, and it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude.
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay.
phases.title: Chapter 1 — open the game, do the meditation first

steps: Finish Chapter 2 and the mission The Cartel Heist. Both Jason and Lucia are playable now, which opens most side content.
Try one of each of the 9 activity types — a race, a fishing trip with Cal, an arcade game — and start scanning vehicles with the WAiNK app.
Explore as you go: clear map fog and study animals through the binoculars. Both feed the 100% checklist later.
phases.title: Chapter 2 — both characters playable

steps: Finish Chapter 3 and the missions Child's Play and Headliners.
Take the side-character finales as they appear — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have a final mission.
Start the Collectible Card sets: 3 of 18 sets are enough for Don't Touch My Deck.
phases.title: Chapter 3 — side strands open up

steps: Finish Chapter 4 and the missions VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory, then the final mission in Chapter 5. Make a manual save before the final mission.
Finish the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands — they are open in free-roam, so none of them can be missed.
Try the airport and robbery one-offs: an unscheduled departure at VCIA, a jewelry store robbed undetected, an armored truck robbed and escaped.
phases.title: Chapters 4–5 — finish the story

steps: Work the activities: 250 stunts (the checklist wants 300), gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, wins at every Top Fun Drone Race location and 20 different races.
Raise and lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, and rob 5 bank vaults.
Complete 50 challenges on the way to the 70 the checklist wants.
phases.title: After the credits — activities

steps: Finish the collections: WAiNK It at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, all garage properties bought, 10 vehicles registered to the Scooter Bros app.
Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts and spend $100,000 across the shops.
Sweep up the vague ones — the Ocean Beach cocktail, the showroom smash, the bowling alley — and check the guides again: their exact triggers are not yet known.
phases.title: After the credits — collectibles, money and cleanup

steps: Open the checklist under Progress, then Stats. Earlier progress counts, and nothing on it is missable.
Work to the lenient thresholds, not to everything: 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 15 meditation spots, 50 of 66 weapons.
Finish A Long Road, the gold for 100% completion — the hardest trophy in the list, per PowerPyx and GTABase — and Vice Got a Price! pops with it.
phases.title: 100% and the platinum
